text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Several days had passed since the minor 
trouble at the shopping district. Haru 
Urara spent her time carrying a lingering 
sense of unease.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Feeling down, Haru Urara confided in Rice 
Shower, who had come over to check on her 
out of concern.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Upon hearing her story, Rice Shower 
advised her that as long as she ran with 
the desire to win in her heart, she was 
fine just the way she was.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Encouraged by those words, Haru Urara 
regained her cheerful energy.
